name: Gym Encounter
source: Late at night in the gym, you find yourself alone with a musclebound hunk you've been watching all evening. His powerful chest, tight abs, and steamy moans ignite something deep inside. As you get closer, touching and teasing his body, things quickly turn heated. This short visual novel focuses on muscle worship, nipple play, and raw gay desire.
